integrity.proof_basis: Explicit monomial moments, Poisson-kernel Fourier aliasing, digamma recurrence, spectral extrema and asymptotics; finite standard-library consistency checks.
integrity.review_scope: Scientific mathematics assessed here; no independent validation is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to the normalized weight \(\frac{2}{\pi}(1-|z|^2)dA\) on the unit disk.
The sharp stability coefficient is infinitesimal at the equispaced configuration for each fixed number of poles; no global uniform inequality is established.
The source comparison does not rule out unindexed equivalents, and numerical checks cannot establish the all-integer formulas.
title: Full Fourier Hessian spectrum and sharp local stability for equispaced Bergman poles
